description: This file declares the WifiManagerWPS class, which implements the Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS) functionality within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes method declarations for initiating, canceling, and managing Wi-Fi WPS pairing and SSID information, as well as data members for caching paired SSID details.
